PHILLIP ISLAND led all the way to win his maiden at his penultimate start, and then tried similar tactics when weakening late off the front at Caulfield in the McNeil Stakes just over 3 weeks ago. This is easier, and he could take plenty of pegging back. 7. REACHIN' OUT resumed in the G2 Silver Shadow last month, and never ran on. PEYTON was too strong in a 4-horse field fresh up at Gosford nearly 4 weeks ago, and has been kept ticking over with a quiet trial since then. He has plenty of options from the pole position, and it won't be too long before he wins another race. 3. BLESSED EAGLE fell in when winning his debut here by a nose, and then was claimed late when third off the front 3 weeks ago, again on this track.
